title: Consiglieres in the Shadow: Understanding the Use of Uncensored Large Language Models in Cybercrimes
reasoning: The paper focuses on the identification and evaluation of Uncensored Large Language Models (ULLMs) used in cybercrimes. While it evaluates model outputs for 'harmfulness' and mentions the removal of 'ethical safeguards' or 'human ethics and norms,' it does so from a safety and cybersecurity perspective rather than as a study or benchmark of religion, faith, or philosophical ethics.
